description: Example requests for the skill-selection evaluation (tests/selection/selection.test.js). 'audience' is the catalog the harness offers; 'expect' is the skill that should be selected; 'business: true' marks ordinary client work, where no authoring skill may be selected even from the unfiltered catalog.
